The following defines a convenience function for loading libraries, installing if necessary.

```{r}
loadLibrary = function(packageName, suppressMessages = FALSE, githubRepo = NULL)
 {
  if (! require(packageName, character.only = TRUE)) {
    if (! is.null(githubRepo)) {
      loadLibrary("devtools")
      devtools::install_github(githubRepo)    
    }
    else 
      install.packages(packageName)
  
    if (suppressMessages)
      suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(packageName, character.only = TRUE))
    else 
      library(packageName, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}  
```

Load some test data to check whether data has been saved/exported/loaded correctly.

```{r}
source("Dataloader.R")
fd <- getData()
```

The main data frame of interest is the "trials" data-frame which contains one row per participant.

```{r}
fd$trials
```

Separate the data set into control and incentive conditions

```{r}
df <- fd$trials 

dfControl <- df %>% filter(condition == "CTRL")
cat("Number of participants in control group: ", n_distinct(dfControl$uid), "\n")

dfIncentiveFull <- df %>% filter(condition == "INCTV")
cat("Number of participants in incentive group: ", n_distinct(dfIncentiveFull$uid), "\n")

dfIncentive <- dfIncentiveFull %>% filter(!uid %in% c('RLZku34Ub4zZ0tFRfNjg', 'd8jivR3bvIzDVfXR6cYF'))
```

When we come to run the experiment on a large batch of participants it helps to have an estimated for how long it might take.

```{r}


trialDurationCtrl <- mean(dfControl$duration/1000,  trim = .25)
trialDurationInctv <- mean(dfIncentive$duration/1000,  trim = .25)
experimentDuration <- mean(as.integer(fd$completed$experimentEndTime) / 60000, trim = .25)

cat("inter-quartile mean trial duration (seconds) - control group:", trialDurationCtrl, "\n")
cat("inter-quartile mean trial duration (seconds) - control group:", trialDurationInctv, "\n")
cat("inter-quartile mean experiment duration (minutes):", experimentDuration, "\n")

```

It can be useful to load the headline data (to join with the trial data, for example). Here's an example of how to do it.

```{r}
hdf <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/sam22_headlines.json")
ihdf <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/incentiveHeadlines.json")
```

Here's an example of how to join it with the trials data

```{r}
dfInctv <- dfIncentive %>% inner_join(ihdf, by = c("mainHeadline" = "id"))%>% select(uid, condition,groundTruth, mainHeadline, trialEndTime,trialIndex ,trialStartTime, duration,prior,share, 'slider-pre-start','slider-share-start',age,country,fluency,politics,education,socialMedia,gender,numTrials, priorRank,shareRank,link,headline,img, oldID, feedback_q1, feedback_q2) %>% rename(headlineID = oldID)

selectedIDs <- dfInctv[['headlineID']]
dfControlFull <- dfControl %>% inner_join(hdf, by = c("mainHeadline" = "id"))

dfCtrl <- dfControlFull %>% select(uid, condition,groundTruth, mainHeadline, trialEndTime,trialIndex ,trialStartTime, duration,prior,share, 'slider-pre-start','slider-share-start',age,country,fluency,politics,education,socialMedia,gender,numTrials, priorRank,shareRank,link,headline,img) %>% rename(headlineID = mainHeadline)%>%filter(headlineID %in% selectedIDs )

dfAll <- bind_rows(dfInctv, dfCtrl)

dfAll
```

List the least performing false headlines based on the number of times shared in descending order in the control group.

```{r}
foo <- dfControlFull %>% filter(groundTruth == 'FALSE')%>% select(groundTruth, mainHeadline,headline,prior, share ) %>% group_by(groundTruth, mainHeadline, headline) %>% summarise(priorMean = mean(prior),shareMean=mean(share),count=n())

bar <- dfControlFull %>% filter(groundTruth == 'FALSE' & share > 50) %>% select(groundTruth, mainHeadline,headline,prior, share ) %>% group_by(groundTruth, mainHeadline, headline) %>% summarise(priorMean = mean(prior),shareMean=mean(share),count=n()) %>% select(mainHeadline, count) %>% rename(shareCount = count)

data <- foo %>% full_join(bar, by=c('mainHeadline'))
#write.csv(data,"low_performing_headlines_v2.csv", row.names = TRUE)

lowPerformingHeadlines <- head(data %>% arrange(shareMean), 50)
```

Plot the sharing rating vs count for the low performing headlines from control group.

```{r}
lowHeadlines <- lowPerformingHeadlines[['mainHeadline']]
ggplot(dfControlFull %>% filter(groundTruth == 'FALSE' & mainHeadline %in% lowHeadlines), aes(x=share )) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth=10,colour="black", fill="white") + 
  geom_density(alpha=.2, fill="#FF6666",aes(y=..count..)) + 
  facet_wrap(vars(mainHeadline)) + 
  expand_limits(x=c(0,100)) +
  xlab('Sharing likelihood rating') +
  ylab('Rating count') +
  ggtitle('Least shared headlines - sharing likelihood rating vs number of ratings')

```

```{r}
calData <- dfAll %>% select(uid, condition ,groundTruth, headlineID, prior, share) %>% mutate(trueValue = ifelse(groundTruth == TRUE, 100,0), penalty = trueValue-prior)
```

```{r}
rmseData <- calData %>% select(uid,condition, penalty, share) %>% group_by(uid,condition) %>% summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean(penalty^2)), shareMean = mean(share), shareRate = mean(share > 50))

tempData <- calData %>% select(uid, groundTruth, prior) %>% group_by(uid, groundTruth) %>% summarise(meanPrior = mean(prior))

fal <- tempData %>% filter(groundTruth == FALSE) %>% select(uid, meanPrior) %>% rename(falseMeanPrior = meanPrior) 
tru <- tempData %>% filter(groundTruth == TRUE) %>% select(uid, meanPrior) %>% rename(trueMeanPrior = meanPrior) 

d <- tru %>% inner_join(fal, by=c('uid'))

d$accuracyDiff = d$trueMeanPrior - d$falseMeanPrior

data <- rmseData %>% inner_join(d, by=c('uid'))
data %>% arrange(rmse)

data %>% group_by(condition) %>% summarise(meanDiff = mean(accuracyDiff), meanShare = mean(shareMean), meanShareRate = mean(shareRate))

cor(data$rmse, data$accuracyDiff)
cor(data$rmse, data$shareMean)
cor(data$accuracyDiff, data$shareMean)
cor(data$accuracyDiff, data$shareRate)
```

```{r}
saveDataTrue
```

Simulating the sharing for each of the 15 participants in the incentive group - each participant is simulated a 1000 times.

```{r}
data <- dfAll %>% filter(condition == 'INCTV' & !groundTruth) %>% select(uid, share) %>% group_by(uid) %>% pull(share)

mat <- matrix(data, nrow = 15, byrow = TRUE)/100

outcomes <- list()

outcomes <- lapply(1:nrow(mat), function(row) {
   false_probs <- mat[row, ]
   simData <- simulateProbs(falseProbs, 1000)
   row_sums <- rowSums(simData)
   ggplot() + aes(row_sums)+ geom_histogram(binwidth=1, colour="black", fill="white")
})

plot_grid(plotlist = outcomes, ncol = 2)

```
